title: Does a slower tap save water?
hook: Filling a 10 L bucket slowly or fast. Which uses less water?

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Distinguish fixed-volume filling from fixed-duration water use.

misconception: A slower flow necessarily uses less water to fill a fixed container.
objective: Distinguish fixed-volume filling from fixed-duration water use.
